children: Arrive AI exchanged prepaid purchase obligations with an aggregate remaining balance of approximately $3.96 million for Series A Convertible Preferred Stock with a stated value of $4.16 million. In a related letter agreement, Streeterville Capital consented to Arrive AI's at-the-market share sales, with 33% of weekly net proceeds required to go toward redeeming the preferred stock. Together, the agreements convert outstanding obligations into preferred equity while establishing a proceeds-based redemption mechanism.
